query: Crude oil prices rise 12% following an OPEC supply cut announcement
event_summary: Illustrative Scenario: OPEC+ members announce an unexpected collective crude production quota cut of 1.2M barrels/day, precipitating an immediate global supply shock. The shock transmits along multiple pathways into physical commodity spot benchmarks, energy producer revenues, headline consumer and producer inflation expectations, central bank policy rate trajectories, commercial banking funding conditions, borrowing and mortgage rates, industrial manufacturing energy costs, airline operating margins, and broad equity market risk premia.

ev-oil-1.title: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report â€” Physical Supply Constraints
ev-oil-1.text: Empirical historical data indicates that an unexpected 1.0â€“1.5M bpd OPEC supply quota reduction shifts OECD commercial crude inventories downward by approximately 0.8M bpd, creating immediate upward prompt-month futures pressure.
ev-oil-1.uncertainty: Non-OPEC shale output response or strategic petroleum reserve (SPR) releases can partially offset the deficit over 60â€“90 days.

ev-oil-2.title: SEC Form 10-K Filings â€” Upstream Exploration & Production Realizations
ev-oil-2.text: Upstream oil and gas producers exhibit an unhedged revenue sensitivity of approximately 75â€“85% to spot WTI crude price fluctuations, leading to immediate operating free cash flow expansion.
ev-oil-2.uncertainty: Derivatives hedging programs (swaps/collars) executed at lower prices can defer revenue gains for 1â€“2 quarters.

ev-oil-3.title: Bureau of Labor Statistics â€” Consumer Price Index (CPI) Energy Weighting
ev-oil-3.text: Energy commodities and services comprise ~7.2% of the headline CPI basket. Every sustained 10% advance in retail gasoline translates to a ~0.25â€“0.30 percentage point addition to annualized headline CPI within 4â€“6 weeks.
ev-oil-3.uncertainty: Consumer demand destruction or retail margin compression by fuel distributors can dampen initial pass-through.

ev-oil-4.title: Federal Reserve FOMC Minutes â€” Inflation Expectations & Policy Stance
ev-oil-4.text: Monetary policy statements demonstrate that persistent commodity-driven headline inflation elevates the risk of un-anchoring medium-term consumer inflation expectations, constraining central bank rate cuts.
ev-oil-4.uncertainty: Core inflation ex-energy may remain subdued, giving central banks leeway to look through transient commodity spikes.

ev-oil-5.title: U.S. Treasury Benchmark Yield Curve Analytics
ev-oil-5.text: 10-Year Treasury note yields co-move with shifting federal funds terminal rate expectations and inflation risk premia, increasing sovereign discount rates.
ev-oil-5.uncertainty: Safe-haven flight to quality during geopolitical escalations can countervailingly depress long-end Treasury yields.

ev-oil-6.title: Federal Reserve H.8 Bank Assets & Liabilities â€” Deposit Beta Sensitivity
ev-oil-6.text: Higher market interest rates force commercial depository institutions to raise deposit rates to stem disintermediation into money market funds, raising wholesale funding expenses.
ev-oil-6.uncertainty: Large systemic banks with sticky non-interest-bearing consumer deposits exhibit lower deposit betas than regional peers.

ev-oil-7.title: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile â€” Net Interest Margin (NIM) Dynamics
ev-oil-7.text: Yield curve flattening and higher liabilities cost compress commercial bank Net Interest Margins (NIM), while tighter lending standards slow credit origination volume.
ev-oil-7.uncertainty: Banks with substantial asset-sensitivity and floating-rate commercial portfolios may offset liability cost increases.

ev-oil-8.title: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS)
ev-oil-8.text: 30-Year fixed conforming mortgage rates correlate >0.90 with the 10-year Treasury yield plus mortgage-backed securities (MBS) option-adjusted spreads.
ev-oil-8.uncertainty: MBS spread volatility or GSE guarantee fee revisions can alter the direct Treasury yield spread relationship.

ev-oil-9.title: National Association of Realtors â€” Housing Affordability Index
ev-oil-9.text: Each 50 bps rise in mortgage borrowing rates raises median monthly debt service by ~4.5%, dampening transaction velocity and widening commercial REIT capitalization rates.
ev-oil-9.uncertainty: Severe existing housing inventory shortages can maintain price resilience despite reduced transaction volumes.

ev-oil-10.title: Platts Global Bunker & Jet Kerosene Spot Price Assessments
ev-oil-10.text: Distillate crack spreads typically expand alongside upstream crude shocks as refiners pass through crude acquisition costs into kerosene and ultra-low-sulfur diesel.
ev-oil-10.uncertainty: Refinery turnaround schedules and seasonal heating oil demand shifts can alter regional product crack spreads.

ev-oil-11.title: Bureau of Transportation Statistics â€” Airline Fuel Cost & Consumption
ev-oil-11.text: Jet fuel represents 30â€“35% of airline operating expense. Unhedged carriers experience immediate EBIT margin compression unless passenger fare yields can be raised rapidly.
ev-oil-11.uncertainty: Airlines with proactive financial hedging (call options/collars) can buffer fuel expenses for up to 9â€“12 months.

ev-oil-12.title: EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey (MECS)
ev-oil-12.text: Hydrocarbon-intensive manufacturing sectors (chemicals, plastics, primary metals) consume oil and gas as both operational energy fuel and direct chemical feedstock.
ev-oil-12.uncertainty: Natural gas feedstock prices may decouple from crude oil in markets with abundant domestic gas supply.

ev-oil-13.title: Institute for Supply Management (ISM) Manufacturing Index â€” Prices Paid
ev-oil-13.text: Elevated energy costs push the ISM Prices Paid sub-index higher, signaling manufacturing margin contraction when downstream consumer price elasticity restricts cost pass-through.
ev-oil-13.uncertainty: Long-term fixed utility purchase contracts can delay industrial cost inflation from flowing into quarterly earnings.

ev-oil-14.title: Empirical Equity Risk Premium (ERP) & Inflation Regression Models
ev-oil-14.text: Elevated headline inflation volatility increases corporate earnings uncertainty, causing investors to demand higher equity risk premia and lowering valuation multiples.
ev-oil-14.uncertainty: Energy sector earnings expansion can partially counterbalance broader market multiple contraction.

ev-oil-15.title: Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) â€” Discount Rate Sensitivity
ev-oil-15.text: Higher risk-free benchmark yields raise corporate Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), reducing the net present value (NPV) of long-duration equity cash flows.
ev-oil-15.uncertainty: Robust corporate earnings growth can offset valuation compression caused by rising discount rates.

ev-oil-16.title: S&P 500 Financials Sector Weighting & Earnings Contribution
ev-oil-16.text: The financial sector constitutes approximately 13% of the S&P 500 index capitalization; banking net interest margin headwinds contribute downward pressure to broad index aggregates.
ev-oil-16.uncertainty: Strong capital markets and trading revenues can offset net interest income weakness at universal banks.

ev-oil-17.title: NAREIT Commercial Real Estate Index Spillover Studies
ev-oil-17.source: National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts
ev-oil-17.text: Public real estate equity valuations track broader credit spreads and debt refinancing hurdles, contributing to risk-off multi-asset asset reallocation.
ev-oil-17.uncertainty: Low gearing and staggered debt maturities among institutional REITs can mitigate immediate refinancing shocks.

ev-oil-18.title: Industrial Production & S&P 500 Cyclical Correlation Analysis
ev-oil-18.source: Federal Reserve Board Industrial Production Release
ev-oil-18.text: Cyclical manufacturing margin compression correlates with downward revisions in forward consensus S&P 500 earnings-per-share (EPS) projections.
ev-oil-18.uncertainty: Strong non-cyclical technology and healthcare sector earnings may compensate for industrial weakness.
